author: staurum
text:
Hi everyone, before i close my eyes for a deep night sleep, i'd like to write a message:

For the last couple of days, i've been getting personal messages from people, incl. Indonesian new members, basically

 "asking for shortcuts".

Here is my response:

I DO NOT HAVE ONE!

With all due respect, appreciate all the hardwork the RTM founders and
all the previous masters here. I still don't understand why some people
is just, I'm sorry for the language in advance, "LAZY".

Last but not least: NO PAIN, NO GAIN. TOUGH LOVE RULES.

Again, i'm sorry and i really wish for the best of everyone. Good night

author: moneydeep
text:
I would like to add to this for all new members coming in.

THERE ARE NO SHORTCUTS.

Just like you cannot become a doctor in 10 days, you need nine or more
years of education and training: four years of undergraduate study, four
 years of medical school, plus one year or more in residency. Similarly
don't expect to become a trader in 10 days. Learn to read the charts.
Everything has been given by IF and now it's upto you to put the time in
 to learn.

It's sad to say but if you are looking for a shortcut you have not reached the point where you actually want to learn to trade.

author: staurum
text:
Hi everyone,

I wish I can modify my last post, but seems like water ripples have
taken effect. I sincerely apologise for any possible misunderstanding
caused. Perhaps, I was just exhausted due to emotions involved in
trading, and the wish to help and share turns into a somewhat
ego/emotion roar. I know I could have chosen a different tone in
delivering the same, if not more appropriate, message.

Anyway, coming with a fresh mind today, here is the trade taken today. I may need your help, this time

Two trades are taken. Would you guys please post each of your own
analysis why i took this trade. i'll post mine for sure in the end.

However, 3rd party views are so valuable to me right now, so while you
learn by analysing this, i also learn by having sort-of- second
opinions. Just like going to a doctor, comparing diagnoses is always
better than just believing in one.

Please do not hesitate or be shy if you are just beginning to learn RTM,
 and absolutely do not be shy nor afraid that the analysis you do may
appear to you as "amateur, many errors, many incorrect zones". This is
the only way that WE as "Traders Helping Traders" LEARN TOGETHER.

So please fire in your analysis. Your help is greatly appreciated.

author: Kavya
text:
Okay, everybody let me try on it!

The 2 blue rectangles are the DZ , upper one I marked because it held
price up, lower one also matched up with LS and also held price up.

Red rectangle is Level formation after engulf of DZ . and after price
FTB to it , it also becomes FL.but then price engulfed that FL by making
 new High.

Orange rectangle is the another Supply which hold price down. and green rectangle is new level after engulf of Orange level.

Now let's drop into M5.

We have left shoulder where level was made on right. but it was tested
on return making new cap and again that cap was tested by smaller cap.
So we have CP down except fresh level at PCP marked by dark blue
rectangle. let's see next chart how price reacted by extending blue
rectangle.
